visual_action: A fast-paced montage of joyful, celebratory, and dream-like clips. The clips include a distorted muppet-like character against a rainbow background, a woman laughing and sticking her tongue out, a man jumping in the air, another man dancing, a woman smiling peacefully with a drink, a woman surrounded by pink hearts, people running on a beach with sparklers, a laughing animated rabbit, a silhouette of a woman breaking chains, a dog in a Minion t-shirt holding a lollipop, a man laughing in a pool, and dolphins leaping in the ocean. All scenes have a sparkly filter applied.
